blocks.text: In the supplied SAP S/4HANA conversion context, add-ons are existing extensions or components in an SAP ERP system that must be checked before conversion. SAP requires their compatibility with SAP S/4HANA to be validated before the conversion can begin. Business functions are assessed in the same way, but they are mentioned as a separate category from add-ons.

A key preparation task is to view both the number of existing add-ons and their compatibility status. This helps identify whether the current system contains add-ons that may affect the planned conversion.

The available material does not identify specific add-on products, explain installation or removal procedures, or describe certification and maintenance rules. Therefore, those details cannot be stated reliably here.
